meaning.en: When a machine, device, part or system gives up the ghost, it stops working completely, often after it has become old or unreliable.
meaning.zh: 當機器、裝置、零件或系統 give up the ghost，意思是它完全停止運作，通常是因為已經老化或變得不可靠。
naturalZh: 當機器、裝置、零件或系統 give up the ghost，意思是它完全停止運作，通常是因為已經老化或變得不可靠。

register.summaryEn: everyday conversation; personal messages; informal workplace conversations; stories and personal accounts; informal product comments.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬於非正式至中性語域。 用來形容機器時，通常帶有幽默或輕微誇張的語氣，適合用於日常對話、私人訊息、較輕鬆的工作交流、故事及非正式產品評論。
register.formalEn: In a technical report, safety notice, formal complaint or repair record, stopped working, failed or malfunctioned may be clearer and more appropriate.
register.formalZh: 在技術報告、安全通告、正式投訴或維修紀錄中，使用 stopped working、failed 或 malfunctioned 通常會更清楚和合適。

examples.zh: 如果水泵完全壞掉，花園便不會有水。

benefits.en: The expression shows that a machine has not merely developed a small problem. It has stopped functioning.
benefits.zh: 這個表達表示機器並非只有輕微問題，而是已經停止運作。

benefits.titleEn: It makes a description more vivid
benefits.en: The second sentence creates the humorous image of the radio losing its final sign of life.
benefits.zh: 第二句把收音機形容成失去最後一點生命力，畫面更加生動。

benefits.titleZh: 可以加入輕鬆幽默的語氣
benefits.en: The wording can make an inconvenient situation sound slightly less serious.
benefits.zh: 我們的打印機偏偏在會議開始前五分鐘壞掉了。 這種說法可以為令人不便的情況加入一點輕鬆語氣。

examples.en: Our printer gave up the ghost five minutes before the meeting.
examples.zh: 我們的打印機偏偏在會議開始前五分鐘壞掉了。

benefits.titleEn: It is useful for old or unreliable equipment
benefits.titleZh: 適合描述老舊或不可靠設備
benefits.en: The expression is especially natural when a machine has shown problems for some time before finally stopping.
benefits.zh: 當一部機器已經出現問題一段時間，最後完全停止運作時，這個表達尤其自然。

benefits.titleEn: It supports different tenses and levels of certainty
benefits.titleZh: 可配合不同時態及確定程度
benefits.en: It supports different tenses and levels of certainty
benefits.zh: 可配合不同時態及確定程度

benefits.en: The idiom is useful, but it is not automatically better than stopped working in every situation. Use it when its informal or humorous tone suits the context.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語十分實用，但並非在所有情況下都比 stopped working 更好。 只有當非正式或幽默語氣適合當時情境時，才應使用。

origin.statusZh: 有較充分記錄的意思演變

history.en: The expression was well established in English Bible translation by the sixteenth century. Miles Coverdale’s 1535 Bible used the expression when describing a person’s death. However, this documented example should not be treated as proof that the expression was invented in 1535.
history.zh: 這個表達在十六世紀的英語《聖經》譯本中已經相當固定。 Miles Coverdale 的1535年《聖經》譯本曾用它描述一個人死亡。 不過，這項文字記錄並不代表這個表達是在1535年才被創造。

history.en: During the nineteenth century, writers began applying the expression to things that could not literally die. An example from 1832 describes a non-living thing becoming completely useless. A broken machine was humorously imagined as having lost the “life” inside it.
history.zh: 到了十九世紀，作家開始把這個表達用於不可能真正死亡的事物。 1832年的一項文字記錄便以它形容一件沒有生命的東西完全失去作用。 人們幽默地把壞掉的機器想像成失去了內在的「生命」。

origin.memoryEn: Imagine that the machine has lost its final sign of life and can no longer work.
origin.memoryZh: 想像機器失去了最後一點生命跡象，從此不能再運作。

rules.titleEn: The subject is the thing that stops working
rules.titleZh: 規則一：主語是停止運作的物件
rules.en: Unless the repair worker died, this sentence does not describe the broken printer.
rules.zh: 打印機壞掉了。 除非句子是指維修人員死亡，否則這句並不是在描述打印機故障。

examples.en: The printer gave up the ghost.

rules.titleZh: 規則二：不要在慣用語後加入受詞
rules.zh: 不要在慣用語後加入受詞

rules.titleZh: 規則三：固定字詞不可改變
規則四：保留時態及確定程度
rules.en: Do not change may give into gave. That would turn a possibility into a completed event.
rules.zh: 不要把 may give 改成 gave，否則會把一個可能性變成已發生的事實。

rules.titleEn: Use the progressive form for clear gradual failure
rules.titleZh: 規則五：逐漸失靈時可使用進行式
rules.en: This suggests that the laptop is showing serious signs of failure and may stop working completely soon.
rules.zh: 這表示手提電腦正出現嚴重故障跡象，可能很快便會完全停止運作。

rules.titleEn: Do not use it for every small problem
rules.titleZh: 規則六：不要用來形容所有小問題
rules.en: A small or temporary problem does not normally justify the idiom.
rules.zh: 輕微或短暫的問題通常不足以使用這個慣用語。

rules.titleEn: Do not confuse it with ordinary give up
rules.titleZh: 規則七：不要與普通的 give up 混淆
rules.en: give up give up the ghost
rules.zh: 停止嘗試； 放棄完全停止運作； 徹底壞掉

rules.titleEn: Avoid an accidental literal or death-related reading
rules.titleZh: 規則八：避免意外產生死亡相關意思
rules.en: This exercise uses machines, devices, parts and systems as subjects so that the intended meaning remains clear.
rules.zh: 本練習以機器、裝置、零件及系統作主語，確保學生清楚理解所教授的是「完全壞掉」的意思。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using give up the ghost.
